title: 未命名草稿093未命名草稿092
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
那李寻道，你看着不起眼，可你仔细想想，自他出现之后，我哪次吃亏了？
这一刻，东域亿万生灵，无论修士凡人，皆感受到天地巨变，空气中弥漫着浓郁的灵气，吸入一口，便神清气爽，修为精进。
凡人寿元增加，修士瓶颈松动，整个东域，迎来了真正的黄金时代。
而这一切，皆因一人——叶辰！
荒域深渊之上，叶辰收回手掌，朱雀真火缓缓收敛。
漆黑深渊，已然恢复平静，封印稳固，灵气喷涌。
他仿佛凭空消失了一般，彻底从这场盛大的双修大典之中隐去。
无数修士早已分散开来，各自寻找适合自己的修炼之地，眼神狂热。
而叶辰站在原地，闭目感悟，嘴角缓缓勾起一抹冰冷的笑容。
“南宫烈，我们的账，也该好好算算了。”
“朱雀圣殿，就是你的埋骨之地！”
一股隐藏了许久的滔天杀意，悄然从他体内弥漫而出，与圣殿中的火焰灵力交织在一起，仿佛一尊沉睡的火焰魔神，即将苏醒！
一场席卷整个朱雀圣殿的腥风血雨，正在悄然酝酿。
而这一切，才刚刚开始。
就立刻滚出朱雀圣殿，再也不许出现在七姐的面前！”
一股浓烈的火药味，瞬间弥漫开来。
一场新的风暴，正在悄然酝酿。
叶辰目光一转，落在瘫在废墟中的南宫烈身上，淡淡道：“你动用禁忌秘法，意图伤我，废你修为，已是从轻发落。”
南宫烈嘴唇哆嗦，却说不出一句话，只能眼睁睁看着叶辰，眼中充满了不甘与恐惧。
叶辰不再看他，环视一圈，朗声道：“我来朱雀圣殿，只为机缘，无意与南宫世家为敌。”

“但，谁若敢主动招惹，挑衅于我，南宫宇、南宫烈，便是下场！”
话音落下，一股无形威压再次散开。
所有弟子心头一震，纷纷俯首，恭敬应道：“我等不敢！”
“谨遵叶公子吩咐！”
声音整齐划一，充满敬畏。
从今日起，叶辰之名，将彻底响彻朱雀圣殿，乃至整个南宫世家。
南宫凤快步走到叶辰身边，俏脸上满是激动与崇拜：“叶辰，你太厉害了！连南宫烈都被你击败了！”
栾傲雪走上前，清冷的眸中带着一丝柔意：“你总是能创造奇迹。”
水轻舞柔声道：“以后再也没有人敢欺负我们了。”
叶辰看着三人，微微一笑，语气缓和了几分：“一点小麻烦而已。”
就在此时。
内殿深处，传来一道苍老而威严的声音。
“好一个少年英雄，好一手上古朱雀术！”
“老夫南宫啸，在此等候多时了。”
声音响起，整个内殿都安静下来。
所有弟子脸色一变，纷纷恭敬行礼：“家主！”
南宫世家当代家主，南宫啸！
修为深不可测，早已是化神境后期的顶尖强者，在整个朱雀域都赫赫有名！
content_en:
Li Xundao, you may look inconspicuous, but if you think about it carefully, since he appeared, when have I suffered a loss?
At this moment, hundreds of millions of creatures in the Eastern Region, both monks and mortals, all felt the great changes in the world. The air was filled with rich spiritual energy. After taking a breath, they felt refreshed and their cultivation improved.
The lifespan of mortals increased, the bottleneck of monks was loosened, and the entire Eastern Region ushered in a true golden age.
And all this is because of one person - Ye Chen!
Above the abyss of the wilderness, Ye Chen retracted his palm, and the Suzaku True Fire slowly converged.
The dark abyss has returned to calm, the seal is firm, and spiritual energy is gushing out.
He seemed to have disappeared out of thin air, completely disappearing from this grand double cultivation ceremony.
Countless monks have already dispersed, each looking for a place suitable for their own cultivation, with wild eyes.
Ye Chen stood there, closing his eyes and comprehending, and a cold smile slowly appeared on the corner of his mouth.
"Nangong Lie, it's time to settle our accounts."
"Suzaku Temple is your burial place!"
A monstrous murderous intention that had been hidden for a long time quietly emerged from his body, intertwined with the flame spiritual power in the temple, as if a sleeping flame demon was about to wake up!
A bloody storm sweeping through the entire Suzaku Temple is quietly brewing.
And all this has just begun.
Get out of the Suzaku Temple immediately and never appear in front of the Seventh Sister again! "
A strong smell of gunpowder filled the air instantly.
A new storm is brewing quietly.
Ye Chen's eyes turned and fell on Nangong Lie who was paralyzed in the ruins, and said calmly: "You used the forbidden secret method with the intention of hurting me and destroying your cultivation, so you have been given a lighter sentence. "
Nangong Lie's lips were trembling, but he couldn't say a word. He could only look at Ye Chen helplessly, his eyes full of unwillingness and fear.
Ye Chen stopped looking at him, looked around, and said loudly: "I came to the Suzaku Temple just for chance, and I have no intention of becoming an enemy of the Nangong family. "
"However, if anyone dares to take the initiative to provoke me, Nangong Yu and Nangong Lie will be punished! "
After the words fell, an invisible pressure dispersed again.
All the disciples were shocked, and they all bowed their heads and responded respectfully: "We don't dare! "
“I will obey Mr. Ye’s instructions! "
The voices were uniform and full of awe.
From today on, Ye Chen's name will be resounding throughout the Suzaku Temple and even the entire Nangong family.
Nangong Feng walked quickly to Ye Chen, her pretty face full of excitement and admiration: "Ye Chen, you are so awesome! Even Nangong Lie was defeated by you! "
Luan Aoxue stepped forward, with a hint of tenderness in her cold eyes: "You can always create miracles. "
Shui Qingwu said softly: "No one will dare to bully us anymore. "
Ye Chen looked at the three of them, smiled slightly, and softened his tone a bit: "It's just a little trouble. "
Right now.
An old and majestic voice came from deep within the inner hall.
"What a young hero, what a master of the ancient Suzaku technique! "
"I, Nangong Xiao, have been waiting here for a long time. "
The sound rang out and the entire inner hall fell silent.
The expressions of all the disciples changed and they all saluted respectfully: "Master! "
The current head of the Nangong family, Nangong Xiao!
His cultivation is unfathomable, and he is already a top expert in the late stage of the God Transformation Realm, and is famous throughout the Suzaku Domain!
